title: Payment Gateway Hardening
context: Legacy payment system with no input validation, processing $2M daily transactions
threat: SQL injection could expose 50K+ customer payment records and credentials
action: Implemented parameterized queries, rate limiting, and real-time anomaly detection
tradeoff: Increased latency by ~80ms per transaction; required rewriting 3 core modules

title: API Breach Containment
context: Active exploitation of authentication bypass discovered in production API
threat: Attackers had extracted 12K records before detection; full database at risk
action: Emergency patch deployed in 4 hours; implemented token rotation and session invalidation
tradeoff: All users forcibly logged out; broke 3rd-party integrations for 48 hours

title: Infrastructure Segmentation
context: Monolithic cloud architecture with shared credentials across all services
threat: Single compromised service would cascade to entire platform infrastructure
action: Designed and deployed zero-trust network with microsegmentation and identity-based access
tradeoff: 18-month migration; temporary performance degradation; 40% increase in infrastructure cost

title: Supply Chain Audit
context: Third-party dependency with undisclosed vulnerabilities in core authentication library
threat: Backdoor in widely-used package could compromise admin access silently
action: Full dependency audit, implemented SCA pipeline, replaced 8 critical packages
tradeoff: Broke backward compatibility; 6 weeks of refactoring; delayed product launch

title: Insider Threat Detection
context: Privileged user with access to sensitive data exhibiting anomalous behavior patterns
threat: Potential data exfiltration; unclear intent; legal and reputational risk
action: Deployed behavioral analytics; confirmed unauthorized access; coordinated with legal for removal
tradeoff: False positive rate of 15%; created tension with engineering team; morale impact
